key_positions: Achieve climate neutrality by 2050 under the European Green Deal
Implement Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) to level the playing field
Reduce net greenhouse gas emissions by at least 55% by 2030 compared to 1990 levels
Phase out coal by 2030 and fossil fuel subsidies immediately
Lead global climate diplomacy and push for stronger NDCs from all parties
Invest in green hydrogen and sustainable aviation fuels
red_lines: No weakening of the 1.5 degree Celsius target under the Paris Agreement
Oppose any rollback of carbon pricing mechanisms
Reject agreements that allow carbon leakage to non-regulated economies
Will not accept voluntary pledges without legally binding enforcement mechanisms
stance_summary: The EU is the most aggressive proponent of binding climate legislation, pushing for immediate, sweeping action across all sectors with strong regulatory frameworks and international enforcement mechanisms.
